title: Who owns the dragon egg
description: This datapack will let players know every 10 minutes who is in possession of the dragon egg
body:
## What it does
- This datapack will detect the dragon egg in the inventory or in the enderchest
- If the player that owns the dragon egg is online:
  - A message will be broadcasted with his name, saying he owns the dragon egg
    - A message will specify if the dragon egg is in his enderchest
- If the player that owns the dragon egg is offline:
  - A message saying the owner of the dragon egg is offline will be broadcasted, his name remaining in this case anonymous til he is back online

## Frequency of the broadcast message
- The message saying who owns the dragon egg is every 10 minutes
